Name: Post
Content:
declare @group varchar(128), @glMaster nvarchar(256), @glDetail nvarchar(256)
select @group = groupby from @@sysDatabaseName..voucherinfo where ma_ct = @@id
select @glMaster = rtrim(val) from options where name = 'm_gl_master'
select @glDetail = rtrim(val) from options where name = 'm_gl_detail'

if @status = '1' begin
  
    exec FastBusiness$Voucher$Posting$Inventory 'm84$$partition$current', 'd84$$partition$current', 'r70$$partition$current', @stt_rec, @@id, 
    'gia_nt0, tien_nt0, gia0, tien0, gia01, gia_nt01, ct_dc, pn_gia_tb, cp_nt, cp, thue_suat_nk, nk_nt, nk, gia_nt21, gia21, gia_nt2, gia2, tien_nt2, tien2, cp_thue_yn, thue_suat, thue_nt, thue, ck_nt, ck', 
    'so_seri, ma_khon, tk_gv, tk_dt, tk_thue_nk, ma_tt, tk_thue_no, tk_thue_co, tk_ck, so_dh2, so_dh3, ma_nvbh, stt_rec_px, stt_rec0px, stt_rec_dc, so_ct0, so_seri0', 
    'gia_nt1 = b.gia_nt, gia1 = b.gia, tien_nhap = 0, tien_nt_n = 0, tien_xuat = b.tien, tien_nt_x = b.tien_nt', 
    null, @stock, 2
end

if @status = '2' or @status = '3' begin
  
    exec FastBusiness$Voucher$Posting$Inventory 'm84$$partition$current', 'd84$$partition$current', 'r70$$partition$current', @stt_rec, @@id, 
    'gia_nt0, tien_nt0, gia0, tien0, gia01, gia_nt01, ct_dc, pn_gia_tb, cp_nt, cp, thue_suat_nk, nk_nt, nk, gia_nt21, gia21, gia_nt2, gia2, tien_nt2, tien2, cp_thue_yn, thue_suat, thue_nt, thue, ck_nt, ck', 
    'so_seri, ma_khon, tk_gv, tk_dt, tk_thue_nk, ma_tt, tk_thue_no, tk_thue_co, tk_ck, so_dh2, so_dh3, ma_nvbh, stt_rec_px, stt_rec0px, stt_rec_dc, so_ct0, so_seri0', 
    'gia_nt1 = b.gia_nt, gia1 = b.gia, tien_nhap = 0, tien_nt_n = 0, tien_xuat = b.tien, tien_nt_x = b.tien_nt', 
    null, @stock, 2
  if @status = '2' begin
	  insert into p00$000000 select stt_rec, ma_dvcs, ma_ct, ngay_ct, so_ct, t_tien_nt, t_tien, ma_nt, ty_gia, dien_giai, datetime2, user_id2 from @@prime$partition$current where stt_rec = @stt_rec
	  exec dbo.fs_PostISTran '@@prime$partition$current', 'd84$$partition$current', @glMaster, @glDetail, @stt_rec , @group, 1
	end else begin
    exec dbo.fs_PostISTran '@@prime$partition$current', 'd84$$partition$current', @glMaster, @glDetail, @stt_rec , @group, 2
	  exec fs20_AfterUpdateGL @stt_rec, '@@prime$partition$current', 'd84$$partition$current', @@id, @@userID
    insert into r00$$partition$current select * from ct00 where stt_rec = @stt_rec
  end
end

delete ct70 where stt_rec = @stt_rec
delete p00$000000 where stt_rec = @stt_rec

	delete r00$$partition$previous where stt_rec = @stt_rec

end

    declare @$q nvarchar(4000)

    select top 0 cast('' as varchar(32)) as stt_rec, cast(0 as tinyint) as sd_hddt_yn into #m$

declare @$exists nvarchar(512), @$warning nvarchar(4000), @$idVoucherNumber char(13), @$nextVoucherNumber nvarchar(33), @$checkVoucherNumber nvarchar(4000), @$checkVoucherBook nvarchar(4000) select @$warning = '', @$checkVoucherNumber = '' select @$exists = case when @@language = 'v' then N'Số chứng từ %s không đúng hoặc đã có trong chứng từ.' else N'The invoice number %s is invalid or already exists.' end select @$checkVoucherBook = case when @@language = 'v' then N'Kiểm tra lại ngày hiệu lực của quyển chứng từ %s.' else N'Check the effective date of book vouchers %s.' end if @ma_nk <> '' if not exists (select 1 from v20dmnk where ma_nk = @ma_nk and ((@ngay_ct >= ngay_hl_tu or ngay_hl_tu is null) and (@ngay_ct <= ngay_hl_den or ngay_hl_den is null))) begin select 'so_ct' as field, replace(@$checkVoucherBook, '%s', replace(replace(replace(rtrim(@ma_nk), '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>')) as message return end create table #checkNumber (r int) select @so_ct = space(datalength(@so_ct) - len(rtrim(@so_ct))) + rtrim(@so_ct), @$idVoucherNumber = case when @@action = 'New' then '' else @stt_rec end insert into #checkNumber exec FastBusiness$App$CheckVoucherNumber @ma_nk, @@id, @ngay_ct, @so_ct, '@@master', @$idVoucherNumber, @$nextVoucherNumber output if @$nextVoucherNumber <> '' begin select @$checkVoucherNumber = case when @@language = 'v' then N'
Số mới đề nghị là %v, bạn có chọn số chứng từ này không?' else N'
%v is a system-generated number, do you want to use this number?' end select @$checkVoucherNumber = replace(@$checkVoucherNumber, '%v', replace(replace(replace(rtrim(@$nextVoucherNumber), '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>')) end if exists(select * from #checkNumber where r = 0) begin if (@$nextVoucherNumber <> '') select 'so_ct' as field, '$Firm' + replace(@$exists, '%s', replace(replace(replace(rtrim(@so_ct), '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>')) + @$checkVoucherNumber as message, 'this.setItemValue("so_ct", "' + replace(replace(rtrim(@$nextVoucherNumber), '\', '\\'), '"', '\"') + '");this._findButton("Ok").focus();' as script else select 'so_ct' as field, replace(@$exists, '%s', replace(replace(replace(rtrim(@so_ct), '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>')) as message return end else begin if exists(select * from #checkNumber where r = -1) select @$warning = @$warning + replace(@$exists, '%s', replace(replace(replace(rtrim(@so_ct), '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>')) end

Name: InternalTransportReportEIDeclare
Content:
declare @mau_hddt varchar(33), @so_seri_hddt varchar(33), @so_ct_hddt varchar(33)
if exists(select 1 from options where name = 'm_sd_hddt' and val = '1') begin
  select @mau_hddt = mau_hddt, @so_seri_hddt = so_seri_hddt, @so_ct_hddt = so_ct_hddt from hddt00$$partition$current where stt_rec = @stt_rec
  if @so_ct_hddt = '' begin
    select @mau_hddt = case when @@language = 'V' then cname else cname2 end from reports where ccode = 'EI001'
    select @so_seri_hddt = case when @@language = 'V' then cname else cname2 end from reports where ccode = 'EI002'
    select @so_ct_hddt = case when @@language = 'V' then cname else cname2 end from reports where ccode = 'EI003'
  end
end

Name: ReviseCurrentStock
Content:
declare @qr varchar(8000), @rr tinyint
select @rr = cast(val as tinyint) from options where lower(name) = 'm_round_sl'
select top 0 ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ma_lo, so_luong as sl_nhap, so_luong as sl_xuat into #reviseStock from @d84
if @post = 1 and (@@action = 'New' or @@action = 'Edit') insert into #reviseStock select ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ma_lo, case when 2 = 1 then sum(round(so_luong * he_so, @rr)) else 0 end as sl_nhap, case when 2 = 2 then sum(round(so_luong * he_so, @rr)) else 0 end as sl_xuat from d84$$partition$current where stt_rec = @stt_rec group by ma_kho, ma_vi_tri, ma_vt, ma_lo
set @qr = dbo.FastBusiness$Function$Voucher$GetSQLReviseCurrentStock('r70$$partition$previous', 'r90$$partition$previous', @stt_rec, @@id, @@action, @Stock, '#reviseStock')
exec(@qr)

Name: CommandRecordHasBeenChanged
Content:
declare @$recordHasBeenChanged nvarchar(512)
select @$recordHasBeenChanged = case when @@language = 'v' then N'Chứng từ hiện tại đã được sửa hoặc xóa bởi người sử dụng khác.' else N'This voucher has been modified or deleted by another user.' end
if not exists(select 1 from @@prime$partition$previous where stt_rec = $stt_rec.OldValue and convert(varchar(19), datetime2, 121) = @$cookie) begin
  select @$recordHasBeenChanged as message
  return
end
